ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In one of the food chain, what is the role played by hawk within that chain?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows several food chains, one of which has an arrow pointing from wheat to field mice, and then from field mice to hawk, indicating that the energy or food relationship is wheat → field mice → hawk. Reasoning: wheat is a plant, therefore it is a producer; field mice eat wheat, so they are primary consumers; hawk eats field mice, so in this food chain it is a secondary consumer.
